# RolePatch

> AI-powered resume tailoring. Score fit against a job description, rewrite bullets for the role, and prep interviews.

## Product

- [Home](https://rolepatch.com/): Product landing
- [Pricing](https://rolepatch.com/pricing): Plans and limits
- [Tools](https://rolepatch.com/tools): Public tools

## When to use this

- Tailoring a resume to a specific job description before applying
- Scoring fit between a resume and a job posting to prioritize applications
- Generating role-specific cover letters and STAR interview prep stories
- Discovering public tools for job seekers (fit scoring, resume analysis)

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://rolepatch.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://rolepatch.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API description
- [Homepage markdown](https://rolepatch.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
